hero_kpi_rationale: External net inflows of 7.0 billion pounds in asset management reflect M&G's ability to attract and retain sophisticated global clients in high-yielding strategies. This metric demonstrates both the competitiveness of the business model and the confidence of global allocators, generating approximately 23 million pounds in new high-margin revenues.

kpis.name: External net inflows in asset management
kpis.explanation: Total external net inflows in asset management in 2025, including flows from private and public markets with institutional and wholesale clients.
kpis.description: M&G achieved 7.0 billion pounds in external net inflows in 2025, including 3.9 billion from private markets and 3.1 billion from public markets. These flows correspond to approximately 23 million pounds in new net revenues. Private markets include 2.8 billion pounds in Private and Structured Credit. Public markets include 5.6 billion pounds in Public Equities.
kpis.signal: Robust growth in external client portfolio in high-yielding strategies

kpis.name: Assets under management in private markets
kpis.explanation: Accumulated assets under management in the private markets segment, representing alternative and diversified investments.
kpis.description: M&G reached 81 billion pounds in AUM in private markets in 2025, up from 74 billion in 2024. This expansion reflects growing diversification of the private markets franchise across multiple asset classes, including Private and Structured Credit.
kpis.signal: Growth in alternative assets and franchise portfolio diversification

kpis.name: Total assets under management
kpis.explanation: Total assets under management consolidating all M&G asset management segments.
kpis.description: M&G manages 345 billion pounds in assets in 2025, up from 315 billion in 2024. These assets include 81 billion pounds in private markets and 264 billion in other segments. Growth reflects both positive net flows and investment returns.
kpis.signal: Continued expansion of managed asset base

kpis.name: Assets under management with external third-party clients
kpis.explanation: Assets under management for external third-party clients, representing the portfolio share from sophisticated external clients.
kpis.description: M&G manages 182 billion pounds for external clients in 2025, up from 159 billion in 2024. External assets represent 53% of total asset management portfolio in 2025, versus 50% in 2024. This increase reflects a successful growth strategy with sophisticated global allocators.
kpis.signal: Increasing proportion of high-yielding external clients

kpis.name: International external assets under management
kpis.explanation: Share of external assets under management from international clients, measuring geographic diversification.
kpis.description: M&G manages 107 billion pounds for international external clients in 2025, up from 89 billion in 2024. International assets represent 59% of total external assets in 2025, versus 56% in 2024. Growth reflects the success of international partnership strategies, notably with Dai-ichi Life HD.
kpis.signal: Geographic expansion toward sophisticated international markets

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.explanation: Total dividend per share for fiscal year 2025, reflecting progressive dividend policy.
kpis.description: M&G increased total dividend per share to 20.5 pence in 2025, a 2% increase, demonstrating consistent progressive dividend policy. This increase is aligned with the group's financial strength and strategic achievements.
kpis.signal: Progressive dividend policy aligned with financial strength and performance

kpis.name: Cost savings from transformation program
kpis.explanation: Cost savings realized from the transformation program, exceeding the initial target.
kpis.description: M&G achieved 250 million pounds in cost savings in 2025 through its transformation program, exceeding the raised target. These savings support the strategic objective of simplification and improved profitability.
kpis.signal: Successful execution of transformation program and operational efficiency improvement

kpis.name: New business in immediate annuities and with-profits
kpis.explanation: Volume of new business in immediate annuities and with-profits products, measuring Life segment growth.
kpis.description: M&G increased BPA new business to 1.5 billion pounds in 2025, continuing to expand its Life proposition beyond traditional products. This growth includes the launch of a retail fixed-term annuity and a with-profits BPA product in the UK.
kpis.signal: Significant Life segment growth via product proposition expansion

kpis.name: Net flows from Dai-ichi Life strategic partnership
kpis.explanation: Net flows generated by the strategic partnership established with Dai-ichi Life Holdings, M&G's largest shareholder.
kpis.description: M&G established a long-term partnership with Dai-ichi Life Holdings, generating 0.4 billion pounds in net flows in 2025. Dai-ichi became M&G's largest shareholder with a stake of approximately 9.6%, expected to reach approximately 15%. The partnership is expected to generate at least 6 billion dollars in net flows over five years and also offer collaborative opportunities in life insurance.
kpis.signal: High-yielding international strategic partnership generating expected long-term flows of 6 billion dollars

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or advanced digital technologies in the 2025 Full Year Results document provided.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, automation or digital transformation tools in the strategic or operational narratives
Strategic priorities focus on financial strength, simplification and growth through traditional asset management and insurance methods
Business growth driven by client relationships, product innovation and geographic expansion rather than technology platforms
